fact: The World Bank appraisal document of 5 March 2021 states that the project, an IDA grant of US$160 million with a US$139 million GPE trust fund grant, will support the National Strategy for the Development of Education Statistics (ENDEE) 2020-2024 in strengthening the National Education Management Information System (SIGE), and that girls' attendance and retention indicators are measured from the annual school census of all schools.
title: Project Appraisal Document on a Proposed Grant to the Republic of Mozambique for an Improving Learning and Empowering Girls in Mozambique Project (Report No. PAD4027)
